cosplay.character: the Chosen Undead in Elite Knight armour

cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Han-era workshop beside a smithy — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a Korean jjimjilbang hall with heated floors and sleeping mats — dries her hair with a towel; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a club powder room with a lit mirror and neon on the tiles — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — standing; a candlelit gala dinner hall — holds a cup in both hands; a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan — standing; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — standing; her bedroom — sweeps the floor beside her with a small hand brush; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — standing; a self-service car wash bay — holds a soapy sponge dripping at her side
